PHIGROS_JIU_GEOPELIA_JUDGMENT_LINE.title: 随身录音笔
PHIGROS_JIU_GEOPELIA_JUDGMENT_LINE.descr: 战斗开始时，获得{GeopeliaSignalPower:diff()}点信号。每回合每打出3张牌，获得1点信号。
PHIGROS_JIU_GEOPELIA_JUDGMENT_LINE.flavo: The line is there. The hand follows on its own.
PHIGROS_JIU_GEOPELIA_SCORE_FRAGMENT.desc: On the first turn of each combat, draw [blue]1[/blue] additional card.
PHIGROS_JIU_GEOPELIA_SCORE_FRAGMENT.flav: A few worn measures, fingering scribbled in the margin.
PHIGROS_JIU_GEOPELIA_STARDUST_BADGE.desc: 回合结束时，若你有至少4点信号，获得{Block:diff()}点格挡。
PHIGROS_JIU_GEOPELIA_STARDUST_BADGE.flav: A small badge that once caught the light of a whole performance.
PHIGROS_JIU_GEOPELIA_PERFECT_FRAME.title: Perfect Frame
PHIGROS_JIU_GEOPELIA_PERFECT_FRAME.flavo: Perfect. A light word that lands heavily.
